subject.title: fix(whatsapp): add listGroupsLive for real-time group directory

question: Should WhatsApp live group discovery become an additive gateway request used by the directory CLI, or should standalone directory listing remain config-only?
rationale: The gateway must remain the sole Baileys session owner, but a process-local registry cannot satisfy a separate CLI; choosing the durable cross-process API belongs to the gateway and WhatsApp owners.

options.title: Add gateway directory request
options.body: Expose an authenticated account-scoped lookup through the gateway and have the CLI use it, preserving the single-session invariant while fixing the reported workflow.

options.title: Keep CLI config-only
options.body: Remove or narrow the live-listing claim and leave the linked issue open because the normal standalone command would remain unable to discover memberships.

recommendation.title: Add gateway directory request
recommendation.body: Expose an authenticated account-scoped lookup through the gateway and have the CLI use it, preserving the single-session invariant while fixing the reported workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent WhatsApp controller lifecycle work makes this the strongest available owner signal for selecting the connection-access seam.
